spans.title: A Drop of Water
spans.blurb: Chained to the pillory, a deaf man endures the crowd's stones and jeers. He begs for a drink, and the last person he expects climbs the ladder.

spans.title: The Last Five Minutes
spans.blurb: A condemned man, given five minutes before execution, divides them carefully: farewells, reflection, one last look. A sunlit church spire holds his gaze until the end.

spans.title: Something Tremendous Has Happened
spans.blurb: At dusk in an Italian square, a young woman sees a stabbing and faints into the arms of a man she hardly knows. The walk home changes something.
spans.spoilerNote: Signals the bond forming between the two leads, a connection the novel keeps in suspense.

spans.title: Gold for the White Whale
spans.blurb: A captain holds a Spanish gold coin up to the sun and nails it to the mast, promising it to whoever first sights a certain white whale.

spans.title: Kings of Kafiristan
spans.blurb: Two sunburnt loafers walk into a newspaper office at four in the morning with maps to borrow and a plan: march into a wild mountain country and crown themselves kings.

spans.title: Something in the Cream Puff
spans.blurb: In a grand hotel dining room, a watchful young woman sees an elegant Baroness quietly take something out of her dessert that should not be there.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows the Baroness slipping in her fake accent, flagging early the disguise the novel later unmasks.

spans.title: The Girl Without a Soul
spans.blurb: On her wedding evening, a laughing girl tells the priest she has no soul, then asks through tears whether such a gift is lovely or terrible.
spans.spoilerNote: States outright that she has no soul, the secret of her nature that the book reveals just after the wedding.

spans.title: The Island in the Flood
spans.blurb: A storm has cut the peninsula off from the world, and a knight wades into the midnight flood, warned off by a voice in the water, to find a girl lost in it.

books.pairNote: Separate scenes with no shared text; the short's soul confession is not the flood story's payoff.

spans.title: The Splendid Security
spans.blurb: An English lord lays his heart, his lands, and the whole world's climates at a young American woman's feet. She likes him immensely. And yet.
spans.spoilerNote: Implies she will refuse this eligible suitor, settling early one of the novel's open questions.

spans.title: David and Goliath
spans.blurb: A giant in brass armor taunts an army for forty days, until a shepherd boy carrying provisions to his brothers decides someone should answer him.

spans.title: A Hound of Hell
spans.blurb: A wild and godless squire carries off a yeoman's daughter. When she escapes across the moonlit moor, he swears his soul to the Powers of Evil and rides.
